messages:
Mara: Quick huddle 99we need the benchmark narrative finalized for the launch post and a compact webinar play. Priority: clear claims + routing for inbound leads.
Alex: Short list of visuals: 1) scatter of median latency vs cost per 1k tokens (hosted/dedicated/private), 2) stacked area for cost vs throughput, 3) interactive violin for tail latency. Keep the headline simple.
Sam: I'll prepare the CSV with fields: deployment_mode, median_ms, p95_ms, p99_ms, cost_per_1k, tokens_per_request. Will also put a violin export for p99 variance.
Jen: For the marketing headline suggested: "Get predictable latency and lower inference cost". Subhead: "Deploy hosted, dedicated, or private with consistent economics and built-in fallbacks."
Priya: CTA idea: "Try your workload60— get a tailored latency & cost report in 48h." Make the form ask expected RPS, avg tokens/request, and compliance requirements.
Noah: Routing rules proposal: if Expected_RPS >= 50 OR Compliance includes SOC2/PCI/HIPAA, route to Enterprise. Else route to Growth. Tag leads with Benchmark_Interest (latency/cost/throughput).
Mara: Good. Also add a hidden Demo_Priority flag set when Expected_RPS >= 50. Alex: For the post copy, call out measurement notes: tokens counted = prompt + response, Dedicated numbers reflect reserved capacity with autoscale disabled.
Sam: I'll upload CSV and a small sample JSON of example requests for the demo. Expect upload by EOD.
Jen: Webinar format: 30m total 9910m big-picture claims + value props, 10m charts + demo (walk through scatter + violin), 10m live Q&A. Outreach: three blurbs 99PMs, Infra, Platform Eng.
Priya: Landing copy will be 1-line hook, 3 bullets (cost, latency, reliability), and the CTA. I'll draft now and drop it here for review.
Alex: We should avoid vendor comparisons. Use relative language: "up to" or "median improvement" with our measurement methodology linked.
Noah: SFDC fields to use for automation: Expected_RPS__c, Avg_Tokens__c, Compliance_Requirements__c, Benchmark_Interest__c, Demo_Priority__c, Source__c (webinar). I'll coordinate with Ops to ensure Zapier mapping.
Mara: Decisions recap: Lead visual = scatter (median latency vs $/1k), secondary = stacked area for cost at scale, interactive violin available in embed. Webinar 30m. SFDC routing rules as above.
Sam: CSV placeholder link: https://internal.storage/redwood/bench_reports/bench_export_1738882000.csv
Jen: I'll build the invite and outreach list today. Mara: I'll post the launch draft for review tomorrow AM.
launch-bot: Reminder: Webinar requested for 2026-04-22 16:00 UTC. Confirm within 48h. :calendar:
Mara: Confirmed. Ops runbook scheduled and invite sent.
Priya: Draft landing copy posted (link): https://confluence.redwood/bench-launch/landing-draft. Ping me with edits.
Noah: I'll validate the SFDC mappings and update the automation thread.
Mara: Thanks team 99Action items: Sam export CSV + violin, Priya landing copy, Jen invites/outreach, Alex coordinate messaging notes for Growth, Noah finalize SFDC automation. Check back in thread with status updates. :thumbsup:
